See You In October

May 25, 2010 • Janice Cotcher

Don’t worry, I’m not taking a break from blogging but I’m taking a break from talking about hockey. Mike Cammalleri said it best:

You start believing what you can be capable of. With the two opponents we were able to beat earlier, you believe you can really make a special year out of it. So it’s still an empty feeling.

Source: Habs feeling empty despite stellar playoff run
